integrity: Two separate exhaustive finite checkers agree on all 282 states, 784 edges and distance statistics; independent expert audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite Heawood/Fano incidence graph only; 2-fold resolving, minimum seven-vertex configurations, token-jumping exchange. No generalization to other projective planes. Publication-overlap risk persists in unindexed material.
title: Fault-tolerant resolving bases and their exchanges in the Heawood graph
